newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: EXCERPTS - CZECH PM KLAUS ON BANKING PRIVATISATION.
newsitem.headline: EXCERPTS - CZECH PM KLAUS ON BANKING PRIVATISATION.

text.p: What follows are excerpts from comments by Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus concerning the possibilities on the privatisation of the "Big Four" Czech banks made at a post-cabinet meeting news conference on Wednesday:

"The governor's and finance minister's material on banking sector privatisation was not submitted to this government session. I expect it to be submitted at the next one or the one after the next because this issue is urgent. I would like the materials to be finalised so we can debate them.
"So it is absolutely useless to debate it today when there was no debate and I expect it to be next week and we will be able to discuss it.

"I am rahter fascinated by how the opinion on if two banks which by the way themselves do not wish it, should merge -- how it is possible to play up this passionately as a political clash -- I can only smile at that. There's really nothing in it like that. That is only the perspectives given to it in your press. It is not a political issue for anybody, if it is this or that way, no party will win, no strong political or other opinion, it is an artificially created bubble which does not exist.
"I can't imagine leftism, rightism, coalition, non-coalition, inner-coalition -- there is no potential in this... I'm not sure if they (readers) are interested so much."
(On the Czech National Bank's proposal for privatising the Big Four)

"I have not the material, which I have laid in this (big) pile on my desk, even opened. There is no reason why you should hurry this up in any way. I absolutely do not understand this, I really don't understand."

(On Hospodarske Noviny's Wednesday report, quoting Klaus economic adviser Martin Kocourek, which said that Union Bank of Switzerland was seeking to help sell 20 percent of the state's stake in Komercni Banka a.s. .
"It seems to be absurd to me that I would ever discuss with anybody the sale of Komercni Banka.

"If I'm not wrong, the debate there is on privatisation of IPB (IPB a.s. ). If I'm not wrong, there is a debate, enhanced by (Czech daily) Rude Pravo, on the possible -- sometime in a few years' time -- merger for strenghtening of two banks (Ceska Sporitelna a.s. , Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s.).

"If I am not wrong, again, Komercni doesn't belong among them. I don't know about anything else, there has not been a word about it. These are things discussed in our banking system... they're only discussed among you, not in the cabinet."
"I do not know about any proposal.
"Above all do not overestimate standpoints of individual advisors and don't give them the status of a proposal or something like that."
